Name: whitebalverines Asian Animals for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from whitebalverines, I have converted their BFAV Asian Animal Pack (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6175) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to whitebalverine for the original mod. 

This mod pack includes:
Chabo Chickens (live in coops, produce eggs)
Onadagori Chickens (live in coops, produce eggs)
Lady Amherst's Pheasants (live in coops, produce eggs)
Mandarin Ducks (live in coops, produce duck eggs)
Belted Zebus and Freckled Zebus (live in barns, produce milk)
Central Asian Boars (live in barns, dig up truffles)
Japanese Serows (live in barns, produce goat milk)

Enjoy!
